timer0Irq.mp2kTimer0Control: SampleFreqSet writes TIMER_ENABLE | TIMER_1CLK, excluding TIMER_INTR_ENABLE
timer0Irq.mgbaOverflowGate: GBATimerUpdate calls GBARaiseIRQ only when the control-derived DoIrq flag is true
timer0Irq.mgbaIrqEventGate: GBATestIRQ schedules priority-0 GBA IRQ Event only when IE intersects IF; its requested delay is 7 minus cyclesLate

videoDma.videoHooks: mGBA Video invokes GBADMARunVblank at VBlank and GBADMARunHblank during visible HBlank
videoDma.startGate: each hook starts only an enabled matching VBlank/HBlank DMA with nextCount == 0, then gives it a deadline and nextCount
videoDma.mp2kRoutes: MP2K configures DMA1/DMA2 as special FIFO DMA, not VBlank or HBlank DMA
videoDma.sourceGeneralCaveat: Scanline and battle-transition source can configure DMA0 HBlank, so Video-started DMA remains source-reachable outside this construction epoch

immediateDma3.producer: RequestDma3Copy/Fill queues a CPU-side request; VBlankIntr calls ProcessDma3Requests after its optional VBlank callback
immediateDma3.execution: the queue manager invokes Dma3CopyLarge/Dma3FillLarge, whose macro writes DMA3 with DMA_START_NOW
immediateDma3.mgbaScheduling: a newly enabled NOW DMA receives current scheduler time plus 3 and nextCount=count; it is not a Video-started HBlank/VBlank DMA
immediateDma3.sourceGeneralCaveat: No source rule drains a NOW DMA before every unrelated Timer 0 deadline; pending immediate DMA3 remains a source-general scheduler class

timer0Crossings.captureBoundary: The all-crossing packet records CPU state and DMA1/DMA2 FIFO state only; it is not an all-channel DMA register census.

vblankEntryObservations.captureBoundary: These are VBlank-entry snapshots before the callback and ProcessDma3Requests; they do not observe every later instruction in that interrupt.

constructionReachability.timer0Irq: excluded for the audited post-boot MP2K Timer 0 path: the source write omits 0x40 and all 256 recorded controls are 0x80; this does not exclude IRQs from other devices or a later Timer 0 reconfiguration
constructionReachability.videoStartedDma: excluded in the exact full-state Video-co-due window: Video leaves all four nextCount values zero and the Timer entry observes timings 0,3,3,0; the finite 113 VBlank entries also have zero scanline DMA control, but the 256-crossing packet is not an all-channel DMA census
constructionReachability.immediateDma3: absent in the two exact all-channel Timer entries (DMA3 disabled, timing 0, nextCount 0) and no VBlank-entry queue is pending in 113 observations; source-general immediate DMA3 can still overlap a Timer edge after other CPU work arms it

explicitBoundary: No Timer 0 service cost, completion timestamp, or construction-clock behavior is derived here.
The Timer 0 IRQ conclusion concerns MP2K's normal Timer 0 control write; it does not erase IRQ delivery from VBlank, serial, Timer 3, DMA completion, or externally changed IE/IF/control state.

Video can start matching HBlank/VBlank transfers in mGBA, and Emerald has source paths that configure them; the exclusion is scoped to the recorded ordinary Factory construction epoch and exact full-state window.

ProcessDma3Requests is CPU-triggered immediate work inside VBlankIntr, not work created by mGBA's Video callback. Empty queue snapshots are finite entry observations, not a proof about every later VBlank instruction.
